Row.Text: Generates the central seal and the Fool, Evernight, and Storm reservations with permanent live visibility. A completed medieval Astral Descent seal city is created at game start. Redemption Victory is the only enabled victory in this mode; all others are disabled.

Enabled by default. After Redemption Mode begins, all living major civilizations enter an engine-level permanent alliance, so no member—including the AI—can declare war. Disable this before starting the game to retain the player's freedom to wage war; with it disabled, AI war actions remain disfavored and AI-initiated wars are corrected, but no engine-level absolute prohibition is possible.
